# Get Ready to Cook, Bake, and Serve in Cooking Simulator - Pizza Shop VR!

**Build It. Bake It. Serve It.**

Create delicious pizzas by placing sauce and toppings just the way you want. This hands-on VR cooking moment makes you feel like a real pizza chef
[media]

**Sauce Blasting Chaos!**

Get ready for messy fun! Use cool sauce blasters to add toppings, but watch out—you might spray the customer too! It’s silly, fast, and full of surprises.
[media]

**Cheese Bomb Explosion**

Say goodbye to boring pizza toppings. Drop a Cheese Bomb, watch the mozzarella fly, and make your pizzas explode with flavor. It’s a mess — and a masterpiece.
[media]

**Unlock New Toppings**

You earned some dough — now it’s time to shop. Head to your in-game upgrade station, buy crazy new gear, and take your pizza shop to the next level.
[media]
